standaard.label: the standard
standaard.title: what every moroww home includes.
standaard.subtitle: every stay is the result of a system. not chance.
standaard.card_geur_tekst: every home has its own sensory profile. it smells right on arrival. not by chance.
standaard.card_label_tekst: only homes that pass our inspection carry the label. no exceptions.
standaard.card_slot_tekst: no key handover. no waiting. guests arrive at their own pace, via a personal code.
standaard.card_qr_tekst: a personal digital guide per home. wifi, house rules, local tips - all in one place via qr.
standaard.card_aankomst_tekst: a freshly made bed, selected care products and a clean slate on every arrival. the basics, flawless every time.

about.market_p1: guests book based on photos. they get a gamble.
about.market_p2: hosts want passive income. they get operational burden.
about.what_body_before: the owner provides the property. moroww delivers the experience. we certify, install and uphold the standard - on every home in
about.check_3: the quality label the market was missing
about.promise_intro: every system exists for one reason: so you don't have to arrange anything and can just be.
about.systeem_01_tekst: every home is physically visited before listing. what you see in the photo is what you find on arrival. no surprises. no lottery.
about.systeem_02_tekst: on arrival you scan a QR code. check-in, house rules, local tips - in your language. the home is ready. no waiting. no explanation needed.
about.systeem_03_titel: the feeling is in the details
about.systeem_03_tekst: scent, light, atmosphere. not by chance - designed. every home has its own sensory profile. the feeling you get is not luck.
about.systeem_04_titel: the standard doesn't stop at listing
about.systeem_04_tekst: homes are monitored. those who no longer meet the bar leave the collection. your next stay is as good as your last.
about.standaard_h2: we say no more often than yes.
about.standaard_p1: minimum 100m². minimum 2 bedrooms. private parking. quiet surroundings. natural light that works. atmosphere you feel before you see the photos.
about.standaard_p2: every home leaves the collection when it no longer qualifies. 30 days notice. badge revoked. tech removed. no exceptions.
about.founders_owner_cta: discover how moroww works for owners
about.founders_p1: moroww is being built by noam landries, together with co-founder brent de baets. what started as a frustration with the rental market became a label with a standard that doesn't bend. not the largest collection, but the most curated.
about.founders_p3: built on the belief that one flawless home is worth more than a hundred anonymous ones.
about.cta_body: are you the owner of a home that meets the standard? or are you looking for a stay without the lottery?

owner.hero_body: moroww installs the technology, upholds the standard and manages the booking. you manage your own home.
owner.tech_body: moroww installs and manages the full tech stack in your home. you don't have to think about it.
owner.sys_01_tekst: keyless arrival via unique code per booking. no key handover. no appointments. the guest enters. you don't need to be there.
owner.sys_02_tekst: a decibel sensor monitors your home without invading privacy. nuisance is detected before it becomes a problem. your licence stays safe.
owner.sys_03_tekst: light, temperature and music are ready on arrival. the home welcomes the guest. without you doing a thing.
owner.sys_04_tekst: moroww delivers and maintains the scent as part of the tech and scent subscription. you won't notice a thing.
owner.sys_05_tekst: water leak, smoke, climate deviation - you're notified before there's damage. a system that watches while you sleep.
owner.sys_06_tekst: occupancy, bookings, home status and monthly reporting in real time. always insight. never admin burden.
owner.fp_body: moroww is at the beginning. the first owners help build the label. that has a different value than joining when the label is already established.
owner.fp_01_tekst: your commission rate of 15% is locked for the full first contract cycle of twelve months.
owner.fp_02_tekst: you work directly with the founders. no call centre. no intermediary.
owner.fp_03_tekst: your home is listed first, promoted first and connected to our guest pipeline.
owner.fp_04_tekst: the stronger the moroww label becomes, the more your home benefits from it.
owner.stap_01_tekst: you fill in the form. we contact you personally within 48h. every home is assessed on location, size and atmosphere.
owner.stap_02_tekst: our team visits your home. we conduct the certification audit, give interior advice and install the full tech stack.
owner.stap_03_tekst: your home carries the moroww label. we start distribution across all channels and via book.moroww.com. you track everything via the host dashboard.
owner.team_p1: no call centre. no intermediary. in year 1 you have direct access to the founders. your home gets the attention an investment deserves.
owner.form_body: we contact you personally within 48h. every home is physically assessed.
